0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-3, 0-2 on the road) visit the Golden State Warriors (4-3, 2-1 at home) for their fifth game of the season. Phoenix is on a two-game losing streak and sits 3rd in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 12th in the West, while Golden State is riding a four-game winning streak and sits 2nd in the Pacific, one game back. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, while Golden State will be without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, following surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, following surgery), and Draymond Green and Stephen Curry are listed as day-to-day with rest and are game-time decisions. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
